USJ BusinessSociety

USJ Business Society connects students across the University of Saint Joseph with business, leadership, professional development, and industry professionals. Open to every major, the Society creates opportunities to build relationships, explore career paths, engage with guest speakers, and gain experience beyond the classroom.

ABOUT THE SOCIETY

Business beyond
the classroom.

USJ Business Society is a student-led professional organization connecting students with business knowledge, industry professionals, career opportunities, leadership experience, and one another.

OPEN TO EVERY MAJOR.

Any University of Saint Joseph student may join, regardless of academic program.
